title: goDiesel lifecycle registry
description: One entry per lifecycle in the repository. scripts/check-lifecycles.mjs validates this file against this schema and against the code.

kind.description: reducer: a pure runtime transition function. disposition: a pure decision for crash recovery. protocol: marker files written by a script. derived: computed from another source, with no stored phase. left-implicit: kept as it is on purpose, with a reason.

summary.description: One sentence: what the lifecycle owns.

module.description: Repository-relative path of the module that defines the lifecycle.

transition.description: Exported function or constant in the module. Required for reducer and disposition.

test.description: Repository-relative test paths. Required for every kind except left-implicit.

adapters.description: Repository-relative paths of the components, engines, servers, or scripts that drive the lifecycle.

states.description: Phase names as they appear in the module. A name may carry a group prefix, as in save:saving; only the part after the colon must appear in the module.

identity.description: What rejects a stale or superseded event, or null when nothing does.

reason.description: Why the lifecycle has this shape. Required for left-implicit and derived.

inProgress.description: Branch that is changing this lifecycle and has not merged.
